description: Lightpanda Browser (serve mode) - built from the Prometheus metrics exposed on /metrics (src/Metrics.zig).

panels.title: Instances up
panels.description: Distinct Lightpanda instances (ip:port) that Prometheus can currently reach on /metrics (up == 1). Instances seen several times, e.g. by several Prometheus replicas or jobs, are counted once. Only targets that expose build_info are counted. Shows 0 when none are reachable.

targets.expr: count(count by (instance) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} == 1 and on(job, instance) build_info{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Instances down
panels.description: Distinct Lightpanda instances (ip:port) that Prometheus cannot reach on /metrics (up == 0): instance down, unreachable, /metrics timing out, or blocked by a NetworkPolicy. An instance reachable by at least one Prometheus replica or job is not counted. Instances that have just disappeared (rollout, scale-down) drop out after Prometheus' staleness window.

targets.expr: count(count by (instance) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} == 0) unless count by (instance) (up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Lightpanda version(s) currently running

panels.title: Active connections
panels.description: Drivers currently running, all protocols

panels.title: Outbound HTTP req/s
panels.description: HTTP requests submitted by pages (excludes internal requests like robots.txt)

panels.title: Outbound HTTP error ratio
panels.description: Requests that failed before delivering a response / requests submitted. Matches LightpandaHighHTTPErrorRate (10%).

panels.title: V8 heap (physical)
panels.description: V8 heap physical size summed over every live isolate

panels.title: Problems in the selected time range
Heap-limit terminations
panels.description: Pages terminated for reaching the V8 heap limit

panels.title: Session timeouts
panels.description: WebDriver sessions timed out

panels.title: Connection-limit deferrals
panels.description: Accepts deferred because the connection budget (server.maxConnections) was full

panels.title: Inbox backlog drops
panels.description: Websocket connections closed for queueing more unprocessed messages than the worker could drain

panels.title: Uncaught JS errors
panels.description: Uncaught JS errors (script exceptions, callback throws, unhandled rejections)

panels.title: Script eval failures
panels.description: Scripts that failed to evaluate, e.g. an uncaught top-level exception

panels.title: Active connections by driver
panels.description: Drivers currently running, by protocol

panels.title: Active connections by instance
panels.description: Compare with server.maxConnections to see how close each instance is to its budget

panels.title: New connections / s
panels.description: Drivers started, by protocol

panels.title: Commands / s
panels.description: Commands dispatched, by driver protocol

panels.title: Unknown commands / s
panels.description: Commands rejected for an unknown domain, module or method. Usually a client using a CDP method Lightpanda doesn't implement yet.

panels.title: Inbound HTTP responses / s by status
panels.description: HTTP responses sent by the server (CDP discovery endpoints, /metrics, pre-parse 400/413 rejections)

panels.title: Capacity & health events / s
panels.description: Rare events that point at capacity or client-behaviour problems. Anything above zero deserves a look.

panels.title: Responses / s by status category
panels.description: Final HTTP response status category (redirects counted once, at the final hop)

panels.title: Failures / s by reason
panels.description: Requests that failed before delivering a response

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Failed-before-response requests / submitted requests

panels.title: Request duration (quantiles)
panels.description: Wall-clock duration of outbound HTTP requests. Quantiles are estimated from fixed buckets (5ms .. 10s), so values are bucket-bound approximations.

panels.title: Response size (quantiles)
panels.description: Response body size. Buckets stop at 4 MiB, anything bigger lands in +Inf.

panels.title: Navigation throttle delay (quantiles)
panels.description: Time a throttled top-level navigation waited before being dispatched

panels.title: HTTP cache lookups / s
panels.description: HTTP cache lookups by outcome

panels.title: V8 heap physical size by instance
panels.description: Sum over every live isolate (one per connection) in each instance

panels.title: V8 heap size at page close (quantiles)
panels.description: V8 heap physical size sampled when a page is closed. Buckets span 4 MiB .. 512 MiB.

panels.title: Uncaught JS errors / s by kind
panels.description: js_exception = a thrown JS value; other = internal failure (e.g. compilation error, terminated execution)

panels.title: Navigations / s by frame type
panels.description: Navigations by initiating frame type

panels.title: Arena pool memory by instance
panels.description: Backing memory held by pooled arenas, including capacity retained on the free list

panels.title: Arena pool hit ratio by bucket size
panels.description: Acquisitions served from the free list / all acquisitions

panels.title: Arena pool misses / s by bucket size
panels.description: Acquisitions that had to allocate a new arena

panels.title: Arenas in flight by bucket size
panels.description: Arenas currently checked out of the pool. Above the bucket's max, every acquisition is a miss and every release is discarded.

panels.title: robots.txt fetch status / s
panels.description: robots.txt response status category

panels.title: CORS initial classification / s
panels.description: same_origin/no_cors need no CORS handling, simple needs response validation only, preflight needs an OPTIONS round-trip first

panels.title: Adblock verdicts / s
panels.description: none = not blocked, allowed = an exception overrode a block

panels.title: Adblock filter rules by state
panels.description: Filter-list rules by fate: loaded into the matcher, skipped as unsupported, or cosmetic

panels.title: robots.txt cache evictions / s
panels.description: robots.txt cache entries evicted to stay within the limit
